A **development build** of 4.0.0, made before milestones M8–M13 and the final 4.0.0 release.

It already includes capture pipeline v2, evidence levels, the SQLite store, identity over time, the truth UI, the private Python runtime and Welcome Center, and history v2. It still lacks deeper diagnostics, the outbound gate, connectors, investigations, map v3, signed updates and the French and Spanish translations.

> Kept for reference. Use [4.0.0](https://github.com/darkckillerc4/MiniWireshark/releases/tag/v4.0.0) instead.

---
**Run it:** download the `.py` file and run `python <file>` (Python 3.8+ with Tk). Check the download against the attached `.sha256` file.
Archived release, kept for reference. The current version is on the [latest release](https://github.com/darkckillerc4/MiniWireshark/releases/latest).
